articles.title: Moon to Gobble Up the Sun Next Week! Here's How to Watch
articles.summary: A solar eclipse is coming Wednesday! Parts of Europe and the U.S. will see the moon block the sun. In Spain, it's the first total eclipse since 1905. Grab your eclipse glasses!

articles.title: Three Countries Team Up for a Giant Defense Pact — But They Say It's Just for Safety
articles.summary: Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, and Turkey signed a new defense deal in Mecca. They promise to help each other if attacked, but say it's not against any country. Other nations can join too!

articles.title: A 2,000-Year-Old Surprise Found at the Bottom of the Sea!
articles.summary: Fishermen off Sicily spotted something strange on their scanner — it turned out to be an ancient Roman shipwreck! The 69-foot-long ship is packed with hundreds of jars that once held wine and olive oil.
